scope: Final independent review of the 11 W3C/NIST review-only source excerpt SVGs
decisionRule: Promotion requires every fidelity, visual, mobile-legibility, attribution, governing-notice, no-mark, no-endorsement, contextual-fit, alt-text and caption gate to pass independently.

sharedEvidence.geometry: Each SVG has a 1200 by 1500 viewBox and is rendered as one fixed canvas.
sharedEvidence.mobileLegibility: At a 360 CSS pixel display width the 24px SVG body font scales to approximately 7.2 CSS pixels and the 18px notice font to approximately 5.4 CSS pixels. The excerpt and required notice are not independently readable without zoom.
sharedEvidence.marks: No W3C or NIST logo, seal, portrait, figure, photograph or institutional mark appears in any reviewed SVG.
sharedEvidence.endorsement: Every render visibly says Context excerpt only and No affiliation or endorsement, and remains labeled HOLD, REVIEW RENDER, NOT SELECTED OR STAGED.
sharedEvidence.accessibility: Every SVG has role=img, an aria-labelledby relationship, title and description. Those structural features pass; they do not cure unreadable visible text or contextual mismatch.
sharedEvidence.fidelityBasis: The render manifest records a source SHA-256 and exact-wording check for each excerpt. This review accepts those byte/text checks only as provenance evidence; it does not infer that a composite is a screenshot of the original page.

records.title: From Words to Structure
passed: recorded source hash and wording check
no institutional mark
explicit no-endorsement boundary
alt and caption accurately describe the excerpt
strong contextual fit: SHACL turns graph conditions into formal structure
failed: mobile legibility
governing W3C notice not established: the package identifies a license-version mismatch while the render cites the 2023 Software and Document License
required original URI, copyright notice and document status treatment not yet proven complete as a single attached notice
records.promotionBlocker: Resolve the exact document-use terms linked by the 2017 Recommendation, attach the required copyright/status notice, and redesign the excerpt for readable mobile presentation.

records.title: Interface Repair in Motion
passed: recorded source hash and wording check
no institutional mark
explicit no-endorsement boundary
strong contextual fit: WCAG principles directly concern interface accessibility
failed: mobile legibility
visual reading order: the abstract continues from the bottom of the left column to the top of the right column, then returns to a later principles excerpt
the package still records an asset-version/date decision gate
the alt text does not disclose that the principles are a noncontiguous composite from outside the abstract
records.promotionBlocker: Choose one immutable WCAG version/date/notice tuple, use an explicit sequential reading order, disclose the composite in alt/caption, and produce a mobile-readable render.
